0022600219.text: The Raptors (5-5, sixth in the East and 3.5 games behind in the Atlantic) host the Celtics (9-2, first in the East and Atlantic), who have won four straight after Toronto dropped its last game. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard, Nate Bittle, Scottie Barnes and Trayce Jackson-Davis, while Collin Murray-Boyles and Immanuel Quickley are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and Boston is missing Paul George due to illness. The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, but the Raptors lost 0-4 to Boston in 2025-26, including a 115-101 loss in Boston on April 5, 2026.
